correctness.rationale: The relation (u,i)<= (v,j) iff equality or i<j and uRv is reflexive, antisymmetric by increasing level, and transitive precisely because R is transitive. Its minimal open cone is singleton plus infinitely many higher-level copies of every R-successor. Thus an infinite intersection with a fibre-saturated set equals existential accessibility, exactly omega_X(pi^-1 B)=pi^-1(Diamond_R B). Inverse images commute with Boolean operations and arbitrary intersections, proving modal formula/ordinal-iteration preservation on saturated valuations only. For R conversely well founded every nonempty P has witness without internal R-successors, disproving P subset omega(P); if not, R-serial B yields omega-perfect lifted P, and C=omega(P) is a closed nonempty perfect superset. Finite transitive K4 and finite transitive irreflexive GL counterframes lift to countably infinite T0 Alexandrov examples, while soundness is prior Montacute theorem. No assertion applies to arbitrary unsaturated subsets.
